about: Small motorboats: an outboard motor by throttle, the pull-cord start, water along the hull slow and fast, a wave slam, running aground and the horn. Speedboats and rafts fall back here.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A small outboard motor on a boat idles in the water: a steady burbling two-stroke putter with water gurgling at the exhaust, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/low.want: the outboard motor at low revs

prompts.text: A small outboard motor at low throttle pushes a boat slowly: a steady buzzing drone with water lapping, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/mid.want: the outboard motor at middle revs

prompts.text: A small outboard motor at half throttle: a steady loud buzzing whine with water rushing past the hull, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/high.want: the outboard motor at full power

prompts.text: A small outboard motor at full throttle: a loud high-pitched screaming whine with water rushing, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the pull cord and the motor catching

prompts.text: An outboard boat motor is started with a pull cord: a quick rope pull, the motor sputters and catches, two separate starts with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
An outboard boat motor is switched off: it sputters and dies with a gurgle, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

hull/slow.want: water lapping at the hull going slowly

prompts.text: A small boat moves slowly through calm water: gentle water lapping and gurgling against the hull, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

hull/fast.want: water rushing past the hull at speed

prompts.text: A small motorboat speeds across choppy water: water rushing and hissing past the hull with regular slaps of small waves, steady. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

slam.want: the hull slamming onto a wave

prompts.text: A small boat's hull slams down onto a wave: a hollow heavy smack and a burst of spray, five separate slams with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small fibreglass boat runs aground onto a sandy beach: a grinding scrape of the hull on sand and pebbles, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small boat's electric horn honks, short and long honks, four separate honks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
